body:
## Android
- **Watched folders**: folders you add with Scan are now watched. New ROMs you copy into them are picked up and cached automatically, within the usual budget of 100 games per 30 minutes. Toggle watching or remove a folder from the Cached Games header. (#235)
  ⚠️ Folder watching is still experimental. [Feedback](https://discord.gg/K7cqutGQJQ) is very welcome!
- **Search** in the Cached Games list. (52de2b7)
- **Update notifications**: if you keep the proxy running in the background, you now get a notification when a new version is available, without opening the app. (#218)
- **Argosy Launcher**: the proxy can now be started when Argosy is installed, even with no other emulator enabled. (2e3a0c6)
- Removed the Add ROM button from Cached Games. Use Scan to add a folder instead. (57ba23e)
- **Automation API**: the status now includes pending awards, the proxy only reports as running once it accepts connections, and the control permission can be granted regardless of which app was installed first. (b09d604, ff77fd5, 1a314c1)

## Linux (all platforms)
- The cache queue now spreads a window's games over the full 30 minutes instead of sending them in one burst, which ran into RetroAchievements' rate limit. The first 20 games still go out right away, and a game you cache by hand never waits. (#231)
- If another program already uses the proxy's port, the proxy now switches to the next free port instead of failing to start. (3958abc)
